BUS123 · MATH M08 · Meridian Advisory Group

Does the interest earn interest too?

Start with the same $1,000 and 6% annual rate. Now hold it for two years.

Simple interest

$1,000+$60 →$1,060+$60 →$1,120

Each year uses the original $1,000.

Annual compounding

$1,000+$60 →$1,060+$63.60 →$1,123.60

Year 2 uses the whole $1,060 balance.

The extra $3.60 is 6% earned on the prior $60 of interest.
